name: Kontoor Brands
outlook:
What Kontoor Brands says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueRevenue is expected to approximate $2.68 billion, representing growth of approximately 12 percent compared to prior year, including the impact of the 53rd week in 2025.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted gross marginAdjusted gross margin is now expected to be in the range of 50.0 to 50.2 percent, representing an increase of 350 to 370 basis points compared to prior year.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted operating incomeAdjusted operating income is now expected to approximate $400 million, representing an increase of approximately 12 percent compared to prior year and includes the impact of $15 million of incremental overhead and other expenses previously allocated to Lee as compared to the prior outlook, as well as higher freight and foreign currency-related expenses.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EPSAdjusted EPS is now expected to be $5.40, reflecting growth of 31 percent.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresCapital expenditures are now expected to be approximately $25 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
